sections.title: Programming Fundamentals for Educational Research
sections.description: What is computer programming, and how can it be used to improve your research? This course teaches the fundamental concepts and techniques of programming using Python, while emphasizing a variety of applications to educational research, including data analysis, data visualization, data wrangling, data retrieval, and reproducible workflows. The course covers fundamental programming concepts, as well as software engineering topics such as writing robust code, testing, debugging, collaboration, version control, and working with file systems. The course is taught with an active, hands-on approach to programming, including class discussions and group work.
